_comment: Terminal geometry, per airport, from OpenStreetMap via Overpass.
aliases FIX WHAT OSM GETS WRONG, and they are not tidiness. JFK carries a
polygon named 'Terminl 8' -- a misspelling of Terminal 8 with its own
outline and seventeen of that terminal's gates. Without the alias, Terminal 8
draws twice and its gates halve.
exclude DROPS BUILDINGS THAT ARE NOT A TERMINAL YOU CAN STAND IN. 'New
Terminal 1' at JFK is under construction, has no gates, and overlaps the
existing Terminal 1 -- drawn, it is a ghost building on top of a real one.
expect_terminals IS THE SAME TRIPWIRE tools/dining USES. If OSM is edited and
a terminal disappears, the run is refused and the previous map is kept.
